title: The Creed in 12 days
about: What Orthodox Christians believe, phrase by phrase, with the Scriptures and St Cyril of Jerusalem.

items.text: The Creed of Nicaea and Constantinople is said at every Divine Liturgy and at every baptism. The Orthodox Church says it as the councils gave it, without the later Western addition 'and the Son' (filioque). Each day: one phrase, the Scriptures behind it, and St Cyril of Jerusalem's lecture on it to the newly baptised.
I believe in one God, the Father Almighty, Maker of heaven and earth, and of all things visible and invisible.

items.father: St Cyril of Jerusalem, Catechetical Lecture 6

items.text: And in one Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of God, the Only-begotten, begotten of the Father before all ages.

items.father: St Cyril of Jerusalem, Catechetical Lecture 10

items.text: Light of Light, true God of true God, begotten, not made, of one essence with the Father, through whom all things were made.

items.father: St Cyril of Jerusalem, Catechetical Lecture 11

items.text: Who for us men and for our salvation came down from heaven, and was incarnate of the Holy Spirit and the Virgin Mary, and became man.

items.father: St Cyril of Jerusalem, Catechetical Lecture 12

items.text: And was crucified for us under Pontius Pilate, and suffered and was buried.

items.father: St Cyril of Jerusalem, Catechetical Lecture 13

items.text: And rose again on the third day, according to the Scriptures.

items.father: St Cyril of Jerusalem, Catechetical Lecture 14

items.text: And ascended into heaven, and sits at the right hand of the Father.

items.father: St Cyril of Jerusalem, Catechetical Lecture 14

items.text: And He shall come again with glory to judge the living and the dead; His kingdom shall have no end.

items.father: St Cyril of Jerusalem, Catechetical Lecture 15

items.text: And in the Holy Spirit, the Lord, the Giver of Life, who proceeds from the Father, who with the Father and the Son is worshipped and glorified, who spoke by the Prophets.

items.father: St Cyril of Jerusalem, Catechetical Lecture 16

items.text: In one, holy, catholic and apostolic Church.

items.father: St Cyril of Jerusalem, Catechetical Lecture 18

items.text: I confess one baptism for the remission of sins.

items.father: St Cyril of Jerusalem, Catechetical Lecture 18

items.text: I look for the resurrection of the dead, and the life of the age to come. Amen.

items.father: St Cyril of Jerusalem, Catechetical Lecture 18
